description: Defines a Room database class for managing task entities within an Android application. Responsible for providing database access and singleton instance management.

classes.name: TasksDatabase
classes.description: An abstract class extending RoomDatabase that provides access to task data through DAO and manages singleton instance creation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of TasksDatabase, creating it if necessary, configured with the application's context.

methods.name: taskDao
methods.description: Abstract method to access TaskDao, the data access object for tasks.
